# Vendor patches

`vendor/gpui` is gpui 0.2.2 from crates.io, `vendor/taffy` is taffy 0.9.0, `vendor/xattr` is xattr 0.2.3, all with local patches applied. The project uses these directories via `[patch.crates-io]` in `Cargo.toml`. Every patch site has a `quiet.md:` comment; the table below and the diffs are the authoritative full list.

Comparing against upstream:

```sh
R=~/.cargo/registry/src/index.crates.io-*/
diff -ru $R/gpui-0.2.2/src vendor/gpui/src
diff -ru $R/taffy-0.9.0/src vendor/taffy/src
```

When upgrading upstream, reapply each patch from the table below one by one, keeping the comment at each patch site.

## GPUI 0.2.2

- `platform/windows/events.rs`: `VK_PROCESSKEY` is always handed to the IME, and is no longer re-dispatched as an editing shortcut after composition ends, avoiding backspace/enter being processed twice with Xiaolang Weasel (Rime IME).

| # | File | Change | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `platform/mac/text_system.rs` | Explicitly enable font smoothing when rasterizing (`set_allows_font_smoothing(true)`, `set_should_smooth_fonts(true)`) | Matches native AppKit / Catalyst text (stroke ink weight 5.73 vs 5.74 per pixel width); about 15% lighter when off |
| 2 | `platform/mac/text_system.rs` | Measure glyph bounds using a CTFont at the same size as rasterization | System fonts switch optical size with point size (SF Text → SF Display); previously the left edge of large-title glyphs got clipped |
| 3 | `platform/mac/text_system.rs` | Fonts whose name starts with `KaTeX_` are allowed to load even without an `m` glyph | KaTeX's symbol fonts (Size1–4, AMS, Caligraphic, Script) have no lowercase letters and were previously rejected |
| 4 | `text_system/line_wrapper.rs`, `line_layout.rs` | Chinese line-break avoidance: `is_no_break_before` (closing punctuation can't start a line), `is_no_break_after` (opening punctuation can't end a line), used by both line-wrapping algorithms | Chinese line breaks in body text and search snippets follow Chinese line-break avoidance rules |
| 5 | `text_system/line.rs` | `paint_rows` / `paint_background_rows`: paint using an explicitly given top position for each row | Rows have different heights when they contain a formula or button |
| 6 | `style.rs`, `styled.rs`, `taffy.rs` | `grid_col_widths(Vec<f32>)`: specify grid column widths in pixels, overriding `grid_cols`; added a type annotation to a `repeat` literal | Table column widths |
| 7 | `elements/list.rs` | `ListState::estimated_scroll_metrics` / `scroll_to_estimated_offset`: unmeasured rows are estimated using the average row height | Scrollbar and scrollbar-drag for long documents |
| 8 | `platform.rs`, `platform/mac/platform.rs` | `PathPromptOptions.extensions`: restricts the file types selectable in NSOpenPanel | The import dialog only lists Markdown / text and .xml files |
| 9 | `platform/mac/window.rs` | `mouseDownCanMoveWindow` returns NO; added `start_window_move` (defers calling `performWindowDragWithEvent`) | The transparent title bar no longer drags the window on its own and no longer covers the app's own buttons; the app marks its own draggable area |
| 10 | `platform/mac/metal_renderer.rs`, `window.rs`, `platform.rs` | `render_to_bgra` / `Window::render_offscreen`: renders the scene to an off-screen texture and reads it back; `Window::needs_draw` | Script screenshots and recordings also work while the window is occluded or the screen is locked (devtools) |
| 11 | `window.rs` | `DispatchEventResult` made `pub` (the return type of `Window::dispatch_event`) | devtools calls `dispatch_event` when replaying events |
| 12 | `platform/mac/text_system.rs` | Synthetic italics: when italic is requested but the font has no italic face (including fonts CoreText fell back to), a "slanted twin" FontId is substituted, sheared 14° at rasterization (WebKit's synthetic oblique angle), with glyph bounds widened accordingly | Chinese italic now slants like in a browser; PingFang has no italic face, so Chinese italic previously rendered upright |
| 13 | `text_system/line.rs` | The scene-ordering bounds for text and background decoration now include glyph positions after center/right alignment, and overflowing text | Image captions no longer poke through the floating toolbar, which previously made the toolbar look transparent |
| 14 | `platform/mac/text_system.rs`, `platform/mac.rs`, `platform.rs` | `font_ids_by_postscript_name` now maps one name to multiple FontIds, and a CoreText-fallback font is matched to the same font by glyph count; added `check_fallback_glyphs` for test use (`editor::text::tests`) | The system's fallback PingFang (PingFangUI.ttc) and a downloaded PingFang.ttc are both named `PingFangSC-Regular` but have different glyph tables; previously the wrong one could be looked up by name, rendering wrong Chinese glyphs in the editor |
| 15 | `platform/windows/directx_renderer.rs` | When compiling shaders in a debug build, the path is passed to `D3DCompileFromFile` as a wide string (previously `to_str().unwrap()`) | Debug builds work even when the repo sits in a directory with non-ASCII characters (e.g. Chinese) in the path |
| 16 | `platform/windows/clipboard.rs` | Reading the clipboard now reads text, image, and copied files together (previously only the first recognized format); added bitmap support (`CF_DIB`, converted to PNG); copied image files are read as images, and other files' paths are split line by line (previously concatenated into one string) | A bitmap placed on the clipboard by a screenshot tool can be pasted, instead of pasting the screenshot file's path; images copied from File Explorer can be pasted |
| 17 | `elements/div.rs` | `paint_scroll_listener`: a container scrollable in only one direction now only accepts scroll input biased toward that direction (horizontal scroll only if the horizontal component exceeds the vertical, and vice versa). Previously, vertical wheel scroll on a horizontal-only container was converted to horizontal scroll, and a trackpad's small horizontal component during a vertical swipe was accepted wholesale; the existing direction lock only kicked in when both directions had input, and a single-direction container's other axis was always 0, so it never triggered | Scrolling vertically past a wide table no longer drags the table left/right; scrolling horizontally over a table still scrolls it horizontally |

| 18 | `platform/linux/wayland/client.rs`, `platform/linux/x11/client.rs` | When appearance changes, the window handle is copied first, and the window callback fires only after releasing the client's RefCell borrow | Avoids a double-borrow panic when the callback re-accesses the platform or updates menus |
| 19 | `platform/mac/metal_renderer.rs`, `platform/mac/shaders.metal`, `platform/windows/directx_renderer.rs` | The two textures used for path drawing (the intermediate texture and the 4× MSAA texture) are now only created on a frame that actually has a path, and are released once more than 1 second has passed since last use on a path-free frame; dropped on window resize and recreated on next use. On Apple GPUs, the MSAA texture uses `Memoryless` (samples live only in on-chip tile memory, cleared during rendering, with only the resolve result stored). On macOS, textures are no longer sized to the whole window but to the bounding range covered by each batch of paths (`fit_path_textures`, growing in 128px steps, capped at the window size): paths are translated to the texture origin before rasterizing, `path_sprite_vertex` takes an extra `texture_rect` (the batch's on-screen origin and texture size), and `path_sprite_fragment` reads texels directly by pixel | Previously these two textures were kept resident per window, about 80MB at 2560×1600; paths are only used for continuous rounded corners, folder icons, progress waves, and hint arrows — the editor draws none of these most of the time. The home and folder pages always have paths, so the whole-window intermediate texture stayed resident at about 16MB; with per-batch bounds it's now down to one or two card-sized textures. Antialiasing is unchanged; gradient fills are computed using translated coordinates, so individual edge pixels may differ by 1/255 |
| 20 | `elements/img.rs`, `elements/image_cache.rs` | Added a `peek` to the image cache that doesn't trigger loading; images with an explicit size can optionally defer decoding until they're actually painted in the visible area | Images outside a card's clipped range no longer decode preemptively; raw pixels, sizing, and animated playback are unchanged |
| 21 | `platform/mac/metal_atlas.rs` | When deleting an image, the tile index is removed immediately, then the reference count of the texture it belongs to is decremented | Avoids a stale index lingering while a shared texture is still in use, which could cause a double delete or reuse of an invalid tile |
| 22 | `platform/mac/platform.rs` | Reading the clipboard now keeps both text and one image format (PNG preferred), skipping empty image data | When a screenshot tool provides both text and image, the body can pick the image while a text input field can still read the text |
| 23 | `text_system/line_wrapper.rs` | `is_word_char` now counts Korean (Hangul Jamo, Compatibility Jamo, syllables, and halfwidth Hangul) as word characters; upstream's test originally asserted the opposite | Korean is word-tokenized by spaces, so UI text wraps at word (eojeol) boundaries instead of breaking mid-word; a word longer than one line still breaks by character |
| 24 | `assets.rs`, `window.rs` | `RenderImage::with_scale_factor`; `RenderImage::hollow` produces a pixel-less shell with the same id and size; `paint_image` skips a hollow image missing from the atlas, records it, and requests the next frame, which `Window::take_missing_images` picks up | After a document image is decoded at display size, layout still uses the original image's dimensions; an image already uploaded to the atlas no longer keeps a copy of its pixels in memory (docs/MEMORY.md) |
| 25 | `platform/windows/directx_renderer.rs`, `directx_atlas.rs`, `platform.rs`, `events.rs`, `window.rs` | On GPU device loss: after a failed resize the render target becomes `None`, and it's rebuilt before the next draw (previously `pre_draw` unwrapped directly and crashed, and the old back buffer would also get double-freed); renderer recovery can be retried, already-released devices and resources are only released once, with no drawing or resizing in between; the swap chain is recreated at the window's current size on recovery, retried next frame; the atlas skips a sprite batch when its texture can't be found; if rebuilding the DirectX device fails, the lost device is no longer handed to the window as if it were new, and is retried on the next vsync; acrylic blur is reapplied to the window after recovery (lost on driver restart, which previously left windows behind the sidebar unblurred) | The app no longer crashes on a graphics driver restart, sleep/wake, or driver update, and displays normally after recovery |
| 26 | `window.rs` | `Window::replace_root` also updates the root view type recorded on the window handle (both `handle.state_type` and the copy in `App::window_handles`) | After the first-launch onboarding page finishes, the same window switches to the main UI; previously, after swapping the root view, `downcast::<NewType>()` would still fail, so code looking up the window by its main-UI type couldn't find it |

| 27 | `platform.rs`, `platform/mac/window.rs`, `platform/windows/window.rs`, `window.rs` | `Window::set_window_min_size`: changes the window's minimum content size after creation (macOS `setContentMinSize`; Windows changes the `min_size` used by `WM_GETMINMAXINFO`; unchanged on other platforms) | Minimum width = minimum document area width + sidebar width, which changes as the sidebar opens/closes or is resized |
| 28 | `platform.rs`, `platform/mac/window.rs`, `window.rs` | `Window::present_next_frame_in_transaction`: the next frame goes through `PlatformWindow::draw_in_transaction`; on macOS this frame uses `presentsWithTransaction`, landing on screen in the same Core Animation transaction as native views changed during rendering; other platforms draw normally | The frame where the sidebar glass (`NSGlassEffectView`) changes size or visibility now appears at the same time as the GPUI frame; previously the GPUI frame presented asynchronously a refresh late, so toggling the sidebar made the glass disappear (or appear) first, looking like a stutter |
| 29 | `scene.rs` | `insert_primitive`'s check for whether a shadow falls outside the clip region now uses the actual range the shader paints (3x the blur radius extra on each side), instead of just the shadow's own rectangle | A shadow whose blurred part falls inside the clip region, while its rectangle itself is outside, is no longer dropped (the inner glow from row-by-row clipping with continuous rounded corners when dragging a file onto the home page) |
| 30 | `text_system/line_layout.rs` | `layout_wrapped_line`: when text contains right-to-left characters (Hebrew, Arabic, etc.) and needs wrapping, it now goes through `wrap_bidi`: wrap points are determined by taking each character's width in reading order, each line is handed to the platform for layout separately (reordered within the line by the platform), and the lines are then joined end-to-end into one layout, with the wrap point placed on the first glyph of each line; trailing spaces at the end of each line are excluded from layout | Laying out the whole paragraph at once produces glyphs in display order; previously lines were cut in display order, which reversed line order for multi-line Arabic text and broke mid-word; other scripts don't take this path |
| 31 | `text_system/line_wrapper.rs` | `is_word_char` now counts Hebrew, Arabic, Syriac, Thaana, N'Ko letters, and Arabic/Hebrew presentation forms as word characters, with tests added | These scripts are word-tokenized by spaces and wrap at word boundaries instead of breaking mid-word |
| 32 | `text_system/line.rs` | `WrappedLine::paint` / `paint_background`: a paragraph that wraps into multiple lines and whose first character belongs to a right-to-left script now defaults to right alignment instead of left (`rtl_align`); single-line text, explicitly specified alignment, and the editor's `paint_rows` are unchanged | Multi-line caption text in Arabic etc. is set flush right, matching how these scripts are read |
| 33 | `platform/mac/metal_renderer.rs` | `CAMetalLayer`'s `maximumDrawableCount` changed from 3 to 2 | Each drawable is a full-window BGRA buffer (16MB at 2560×1600); the third one only gets created, and stays allocated, when frames back up. Our GPU time per frame is only one or two milliseconds, and `nextDrawable` waits at most 0.17ms while scrolling a folder page — the same as with 3 |

## taffy 0.9.0

| File | Change | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `compute/grid/track_sizing.rs` | The "exceeds limits" phase now only distributes space to the affected tracks, and the growth cap only looks at the `fit-content()` argument. Ported from a fix in taffy 0.13 | A merged cell spanning multiple auto rows previously failed to grow those rows under a min-content constraint |

## xattr 0.2.3

| File | Change | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `src/sys/mod.rs` | On Linux/Android, `ENOATTR` is mapped to `::libc::ENODATA` | Fixes a compile error on modern libc crates on Linux GNU, which lack an `ENOATTR` constant |

## Removed upstream files

`gpui/examples/image/black-cat-typing.gif` (4.3 MB) is only used by `examples/gif_viewer.rs` and `examples/opacity.rs`, neither of which is part of this project's build; removed to reduce repo size.
